tagline.en_US: Build and run automation flows from a self-hosted visual interface. This single-container profile uses Activepieces’ documented personal mode with embedded storage and an in-memory queue.

description.en_US: Activepieces is an open-source workflow automation platform designed to connect applications and streamline tasks. It features a visual flow builder equipped with branches, loops, retries, and versioning. Users can integrate AI providers, build custom tools, and automate business processes with an extensive ecosystem of community-contributed components.
